title: Country Perspectives: The Republic of Korea’s Journey
content: The Republic of Korea's Journey in the "Unlocking IP-backed Financing Series" examines how Korea has built a comprehensive IP finance ecosystem through sustained legal, institutional, and policy efforts, more than doubling its market volume. Additionally, the report highlights the emergence of creative industries as a new frontier for IP finance and outlines Korea's strategy for transitioning toward a sustainable, market-oriented system, offering key insights for global policymakers and financial institutions.
